name: BluePilot: hybrid gauges, lead overlay, confidence ball
author: CommaView
description: What BluePilot (BluePilotDev/bluepilot) draws on top of sunnypilot's onroad screen, each where the driver turned it on in BluePilot's settings: the Ford hybrid battery and power flow gauges, the brake lights, the lateral mode letter (A / C / OP), the confidence ball, the pulsing blind spot screen edges, BluePilot's lane lines, the radar lead overlay (distance, speed, time gap) and the comma four's lower-right complication. BluePilot only.
